database_path.description: Absolute path to the main SQLite database file storing repositories, tickets, wiki pages, and metadata.

host.description: IP address or hostname to bind the HTTP server to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '0.0.0.0').

port.description: Port number for the HTTP server.

cgi_path.description: Path where Fossil expects to be invoked via CGI (e.g., '/cgi-bin/fossil').

ssl.description: Enable HTTPS support. Requires valid certificate/key paths.

ssl_cert.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format).

ssl_key.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous HTTP connections (0 = unlimited).

keep_alive_timeout.description: Seconds before closing idle keep-alive connections.

log_file.description: Path to log file (empty = log to stderr/stdout).

debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output in logs.

url.description: Base URL used for generating absolute links (e.g., in emails).

site_title.description: Title shown in the web interface header.

custom_header.description: Raw HTML to inject into every page’s <head> section.

enabled.description: Require login for most operations. If false, anonymous read access is allowed (no login needed).

anonymous_user.description: Name of the special anonymous user account. Empty = fully anonymous, 'anonymous' = named anonymous.

self_register.description: Allow new users to register accounts themselves (requires authentication enabled).

wiki.description: Enable the built-in wiki system for collaborative documentation.

tickets.description: Enable the ticketing system for bug reports and task management.

graph.description: Enable the timeline graph view showing branch and merge relationships.

json_api.description: Enable the JSON-based remote API for programmatic access.

default.name: allow-wiki
default.description: Enable wiki editing for project administrators

repo_defaults.description: List of global defaults for new repositories (format: repo-default: name value).

access_rules.description: Explicit access control rules for specific users/projects (optional).

permission.description: Access level (read=view only, write=commit+wiki+tickets, admin=full control).

mail.description: SMTP configuration for ticket/notification emails (optional; leave host blank to disable).

smtp_port.description: SMTP port (587 for STARTTLS, 465 for implicit TLS).

smtp_starttls.description: Upgrade connection to TLS using STARTTLS.
